updates.headline: City Hall announces expanded congestion pricing relief fund
updates.body: Mayor's office confirmed $40M in relief funds for small businesses impacted by congestion pricing in lower Manhattan, with applications opening April 1.

updates.headline: Gowanus rezoning moves to final public review
updates.body: The Gowanus neighborhood rezoning plan enters its 60-day public comment period, potentially adding 8,000 new housing units near the canal.

updates.headline: Jamaica Bay water quality initiative launches
updates.body: A new multi-agency effort to reduce runoff into Jamaica Bay kicks off this spring, targeting improved water quality by 2028.

updates.headline: New Bronx Community Land Trust secures $12M
updates.body: The South Bronx CLT received $12M in city funding to preserve 200 affordable units in Mott Haven over the next decade.

updates.headline: North Shore ferry expansion studied
updates.body: DOT is studying three new ferry landing sites along the North Shore to reduce car dependency and improve transit access.
